title: Model-informed precision dosing for linezolid: a randomized clinical trial
official: Model-informed precision dosing for linezolid: a randomized clinical trial
summary: Main objective: To determine whether model-informed precision dosing optimizes linezolid dosing in order to better achieve a therapeutic trough concentration compared to standard dosing.
conditions: Bacterial infection (pneumonia, skin or soft tissue infection) requiring treatment with linezolid in patients in intensive care unit
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult trial participants a)	≥ 18 years of age b)	Linezolid treatment is indicated or has been started due to pneumonia, skin or soft tissue infection; the patient has received no more than 2 infusions of 600 mg linezolid each
2. Participation  a)	with written informed consent of the patient or, Alternatively, but only if the patient is temporarily incapable of giving informed consent  b)	with written informed consent of his/her legally designated representative or c)	after using the option of inclusion via spouse according to § 1358 BGB or  d)	according to article 35 of the CTR and with obtaining the patients informed consent as soon as possible
3. Patients with potential childbearing ability: negative pregnancy test
Exclusion criteria:
1. Infection other than pneumonia, skin or soft tissue infection, especially tuberculosis, endocarditis and osteomyelitis
2. Concomitant treatment with monoamine oxidase inhibitors (e.g. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, tranylcypromine, moclobemide or selegiline)
3. Patients whose life expectancy is less than 7 days
4. Pregnancy
5. Lactation/breastfeeding
6. Previous participation in this study
7. Simultaneous participation or participation in the past 4 weeks in another clinical trial with other medicinal products
